title: High-power laser welding
description:
A laser welding test at LWT (Lindoe Welding Technology). The 32 kW laser system is in this test limited to 12 kW.
The invisible laser beam is coming directly from above. Inert gas from the big nozzle flows around the weld bead and compressed air from the small nozzle removes fumes.
author: Krorc
